scope: Within-source research comparison on new genomic host groups and the same 42 Kaneko study phages. This does not test the existing 94-output weights or establish independent release validation.

dataset.host_rule: All 143 source-run-linked assemblies from sequence intake v1. No label-, ST- or quality-metric-dependent filtering.

missing_host.reason: No assembled genome in the inspected original-BioSample routes; excluded from this available-genome cohort in every partition. Existing phenotype observations remain preserved.

dataset.T6: Inventory/ANI only, not measured in SF2. No labels are generated.
dataset.later_genomes: Adding host 127 or changing genomes requires a new cohort/protocol version, not an append to this test set.

endpoint.primary_target: Source grade == 3 versus observed grades 0,1,2; complete spot clearing versus not complete clearing under this assay.
endpoint.semantic_limit: Target 0 is not complete clearing, not proof of no infection. Grade 3 is not proof of productive infection or clinical efficacy.
endpoint.unknown_rule: Reject empty/invalid required source cells; never fill an unknown with zero.

secondary_threshold.operation: Evaluate the same frozen primary-target scores at this readout as a descriptive sensitivity only. No refit, selection or replacement of the primary target.

endpoint.abstract_discrepancy: The abstract Wec277 percentage remains unreconciled. The explicit workbook grade definitions and this declared endpoint govern this research comparison.

grouping.algorithm: Union all qualifying pairs and exact canonical assembly matches transitively. Group ID is the smallest host ID in the component. Thresholds are operational leakage guards, not a universal strain definition.
grouping.pair_scope: All 10,153 unordered host pairs must be present with finite ANI and both aligned fractions. Missing/skipped pairs block the freeze; they are not treated as distant.
grouping.sensitivity_use: Report group counts only at fixed AF=90. Do not change the primary grouping/split or fit alternative models from these findings.

split.rule: Sort primary group IDs by SHA-256 of UTF-8 20261114:<group_id>, then group ID. First floor(G/5) groups are test, next floor(G/5) validation, remainder train. Never split components or retry seeds for label balance.

roles.train: Fit preprocessing and the two fixed methods.
roles.validation: Report the already-fixed methods; no hyperparameter or endpoint selection.
roles.test: Evaluate once after implementation and training artifacts are frozen.

split.refit: No train-plus-validation refit; one train fit per phage with the fixed C. Keep the resulting model for validation and test.
split.failure: If fewer than 10 genomic groups or a required partition is empty, report the frozen design blocked without changing thresholds or seeds.

prevalence.candidate_scope: All 42 named study phages, even those with no train grade-3 outcome.

host_4mer.features: Existing host_fourmers: within-contig, strand-canonical frequencies of 136 DNA 4-mer bins; skip ambiguous windows, never concatenate contigs.
host_4mer.scaling: Existing HostFeatureEncoder, fit means/scales on unique training hosts only; no categorical features.
host_4mer.model: One fixed logistic classifier per named phage, lbfgs, C=0.1, max_iter=2000, no class weighting, equal observed-pair weights.
host_4mer.single_class_fallback: Beta(1,1) training prevalence; do not remove the candidate.
host_4mer.artifact_endpoint: New runner must bind weights/scores to complete-spot-clearing-grade3, the 42-phage library and frozen training hosts. The historical fitter hardcodes MLC semantics; an endpoint-aware wrapper must not propagate that descriptor or load 94-output weights.
host_4mer.score: Uncalibrated source-target ranking score. No infection-probability or treatment interpretation.
host_4mer.failure: Stop on nonconvergence, nonfinite scores or incomplete 42-candidate support. Do not expand C, change seeds or drop candidates.

evaluation.primary: All-complete-host macro Hit@2 for host_4mer minus prevalence on the frozen test set.
other_metrics: Recall@K on hosts with at least one primary-positive candidate
MRR, with zero for all-primary-negative hosts
Capped tests consumed at K=2 and K=5
evaluation.ties: Exact expectation over uniform permutations within exact-score ties; display-order tie breaking must not affect metrics.
evaluation.all_negative_hosts: Retain in primary Hit@K, MRR and cost denominators.
evaluation.cost: E[min(T,K)] = K - sum(Hit@j for j=1..K-1), equal-cost sequential candidate tests. Include all intermediate j through 4 for K=5.
evaluation.scope: Every held-out host is scored against the same 42 candidates. No outcome-driven library filtering. Pooled pair AP/AUROC are diagnostics only.

uncertainty.unit: Whole primary genomic groups within the complete held-out host universe, paired resampling across methods. Keep within-group hosts together; apply positive-eligible masks after group sampling.
uncertainty.interval: Pointwise percentile interval conditional on the fixed inspected cohort, library, split and fitted models.

decision.hit_gain: Supported research Hit@2 gain only if the primary paired lower 95% bound exceeds zero.
decision.cost_gain: Supported research cost reduction at K=2 only if the paired host_4mer-minus-prevalence upper 95% bound is below zero.
decision.joint_benefit: Require both hit and cost criteria; preserve all failures. No K/seed/target/threshold search after test inspection.
decision.release: No release promotion or stable superiority claim follows from this inspected, single-source research panel.

source_review.phenotype_license: No open phenotype-data license verified; original workbooks and bulk grades are not redistributed.
pending: Experimental-stock identity beyond source number/name/run joins
Cross-source near-duplicate comparison with the prior 177 hosts
source_review.permitted_claim_scope: Within-source grouped-host research comparison only; not independent validation of the old model.

execution_boundary: This phase computes genomic similarity and freezes a protocol only. No susceptibility-model fit or candidate scoring.
